Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler starts low, down on the G pair, then jumps up to the E pair for a part that tumbles down the scale. It was in print by the 1840s.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler počinje nisko, na paru G, pa skače na par E za dio koji se spušta ljestvicom. Tiskana je najkasnije u 1840-ima.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pair 4, frets 2 and 4, then the open D pair.
rows.translation: Par 4, pragovi 2 i 4, pa prazni par D.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the high part begin?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: On A, fret 5 of the E pair
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It opens on A at fret 5 of pair 1, then walks down through G, F♯ and E.
rows.translation: Počinje na A na pragu 5 para 1, pa silazi kroz G, F♯ i E.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-4 “Arkansas Traveler” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A new key and a twist
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A, so you use C♯ and G♯. In the second part, G♯ drops to plain G on fret 3 of the E pair. That one note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je u A, pa koristiš C♯ i G♯. U drugom dijelu G♯ pada na obični G na pragu 3 para E. Taj jedan ton daje melodiji starinski zvuk.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: G♯ on pair 3, fret 6; the open A pair; then G on pair 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: G♯ na paru 3, pragu 6; prazni par A; pa G na paru 1, pragu 3.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time sound?
rows.translation: Koji ton daje drugom dijelu starinski zvuk?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A major uses G♯. Lowering it to G gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: A-dur koristi G♯. Spuštanje na G daje miksolidijski zvuk koji se provlači kroz starinsku i bluegrass glazbu.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · song man-5-5 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play each tune through at a steady tempo. If a note slips, keep your picking hand moving and catch the next beat. That is how real jams work.
rows.translation: Odsviraj svaku melodiju u stalnom tempu. Ako ton izmakne, nastavi pokret ruke s trzalicom i uhvati sljedeću dobu. Tako rade prave zajedničke svirke.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which tune swaps G♯ for G?
rows.translation: Koja melodija mijenja G♯ u G?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in A but uses G in its second part. That lowered note is its signature.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je u A, ali u drugom dijelu koristi G. Taj sniženi ton njegov je potpis.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 5 · challenge man-5-6 “Jam-session challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Add the left-hand moves and rolling right hand that make a tune sound like bluegrass.
rows.translation: Dodaj pokrete lijeve i tekuće obrasce desne ruke koji daju melodiji bluegrass zvuk.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 “Slides, hammers and crosspicking” · unit summary

rows.source: Pick a note, then keep pressing as you glide the same finger up to a higher fret. The new note sounds without a second pick stroke. Light, steady pressure is the trick.
rows.translation: Trzni ton, pa nastavi pritiskati dok istim prstom kliziš do višeg praga. Novi ton zvuči bez drugog trzaja. Tajna je lagan, stalan pritisak.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What sounds the second note in a slide?
rows.translation: Što oglašava drugi ton pri klizanju?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Your finger pressing as it moves
rows.translation: Prst koji pritišće dok se pomiče
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressure on the string as you slide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Trzaš samo prvi ton. Zadrži pritisak na žici dok kliziš, inače će se ton putem ugasiti.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-1 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · title

rows.source: Pick an open pair, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick stroke.
rows.translation: Trzni prazni par, pa brzo spusti vrh prsta odmah iza praga 2. Novi ton nastaje samo od udarca, bez drugog trzaja.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: The reverse: with a finger on fret 2, pick, then pull the finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open note below.
rows.translation: Obrnuto: s prstom na pragu 2 trzni, pa pri podizanju malo povuci prst ustranu. Taj trzaj oglasi prazni ton ispod.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: Which moves sound a note without the pick?
rows.translation: Koji pokreti oglašavaju ton bez trzalice?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: All three sound a second note with the fretting hand. The pick plays only the first.
rows.translation: Sva tri oglašavaju drugi ton rukom na vratu. Trzalica svira samo prvi.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-2 “Hammer-ons and pull-offs” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Fiddle tunes come alive with small ornaments. Here the two plain A notes that open Old Joe Clark become A, B, A: a hammer-on and a pull-off.
rows.translation: Tradicijske melodije ožive s malim ukrasima. Ovdje dva obična tona A na početku Old Joe Clark postaju A, B, A: hammer-on i pull-off.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In A, B, A, how many times do you pick?
rows.translation: Koliko puta trzaš u A, B, A?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-3 “Dress up a tune” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Pick the first A, hammer on to B and pull off back to A. One pick, three notes.
rows.translation: Trzni prvi A, udari prstom do B pa pull-offom natrag do A. Jedan trzaj, tri tona.

rows.source: Crosspicking picks single notes across three pairs in a repeating pattern, so a chord sounds like a ripple. Eight notes split three, three and two.
rows.translation: Križno trzanje svira pojedine tonove preko triju parova u ponavljanom obrascu, pa akord zvuči kao valić. Osam nota dijeli se na tri, tri i dvije.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How are the eight notes of a crosspicking bar grouped?
rows.translation: Kako su grupirane osam nota takta križnog trzanja?
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
rows.translation: Obrazac od tri tona ponavljan kroz takt od osam svaki put pomiče naglasak. Tako nastaje osjećaj kotrljanja.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · lesson man-6-4 “Crosspicking” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Ripple through G, C and D
rows.translation: Valić kroz G, C i D

Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slides, hammer-ons, chops and crosspicking. Take each one at your own pace, and keep the beat steady above all.
rows.translation: Slide, hammer-on, prigušeni udari i križno trzanje. Svako uzmi svojim tempom, a iznad svega drži ravnomjeran ritam.
rows.context: Mandolin · Unit 6 · challenge man-6-5 “Bluegrass mandolin challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which beats does the chop land on?

rows.source: Five-string, open G: rolls, old-time tunes and clawhammer
rows.translation: Pet žica, otvoreni G: obrasci, stare melodije i clawhammer

Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · title

rows.source: Meet the five strings, tune to open G, find the drone string and play a song.
rows.translation: Upoznaj pet žica, ugodi na otvoreni G, pronađi bordunsku žicu i odsviraj pjesmu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 “Hello, banjo” · unit summary
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A banjo has four full-length strings and a fifth that starts partway up the neck, at its own little tuning peg. That short string is the banjo's signature sound.
rows.translation: Bendžo ima četiri žice pune duljine i petu koja počinje na dijelu vrata, kod svoje male čivije. Ta kratka žica daje bendžu prepoznatljiv zvuk.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: String 1 is the thin one nearest the floor. Strings 2, 3 and 4 follow toward your face. The short one on top is string 5.
rows.translation: Žica 1 tanka je i najbliža podu. Žice 2, 3 i 4 slijede prema licu. Kratka na vrhu je žica 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string is the short one?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: The fifth string lies next to string 4 but starts at the fifth fret, with its peg on the side of the neck.
rows.translation: Peta žica leži pokraj žice 4, ali počinje na petom pragu, s čivijom sa strane vrata.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the thin one nearest the floor.
rows.translation: Trzni žicu 1, tanku i najbližu podu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the short string, string 5. Pluck it with your thumb.
rows.translation: Sada kratku žicu, žicu 5. Trzni je palcem.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-1 “Meet your banjo” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Standard banjo tuning is open G. From string 4 to string 1 it reads D, G, B, D, and the short fifth string is a high G. Strummed open, they make a G chord.
rows.translation: Standardno ugađanje bendža je otvoreni G. Od žice 4 do žice 1 ide D, G, B, D, a kratka peta žica je visoki G. Prazne žice zajedno daju akord G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Strings 4, 3, 2 and 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.translation: Žice 4, 3, 2 i 1: D, G, B, D.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: What chord do the open strings make?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G, B and D are the notes of a G chord. That is why this tuning is called open G.
rows.translation: G, B i D tonovi su akorda G. Zato se ovo ugađanje zove otvoreni G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-2 “Open G tuning” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · title
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bluegrass banjo uses a plastic thumb pick and two metal finger picks, on index and middle. The finger picks point down, curving the same way as your fingertips.
rows.translation: Bluegrass bendžo koristi plastičnu trzalicu za palac i dvije metalne za kažiprst i srednji prst. Prstne trzalice pokazuju dolje, savijene kao vrhovi prstiju.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: For now your thumb plays strings 3, 4 and 5, your index plays string 2 and your middle plays string 1. Rest your ring and little fingers lightly on the head.
rows.translation: Zasad palac svira žice 3, 4 i 5, kažiprst žicu 2, a srednji žicu 1. Prstenjak i mali prst lagano nasloni na membranu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Thumb takes strings 3, 4 and 5, index takes string 2 and middle takes string 1.
rows.translation: Palac svira žice 3, 4 i 5, kažiprst žicu 2, a srednji prst žicu 1.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-3 “Thumb, index, middle” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The fifth string is a drone: you play it open, between melody notes, and it rings over everything. In these lessons you never fret it.
rows.translation: Peta žica je bordun: sviraš je praznu između tonova melodije i ona zvoni iznad svega. U ovim lekcijama nikad je ne pritišćeš na pragu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: First string 5, then string 1. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Prvo žica 5, pa žica 1. Koja je viša?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.source: Why does the fifth string sound so high?
rows.translation: Zašto peta žica zvuči tako visoko?

rows.source: It is short and tuned to high G
rows.translation: Kratka je i ugođena na visoki G

Banjo · Unit 1 · lesson bjo-1-4 “The drone string” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Being short lets it hold a high G. It sits on top of the melody like a bell.
rows.translation: Kratka duljina omogućuje visoki G. Sjedi iznad melodije poput zvona.

rows.source: Tuned to open G, picks on, thumb ready for the drone. Play each string cleanly and let it ring.
rows.translation: Ugođeno na otvoreni G, trzalice na prstima, palac spreman za bordun. Sviraj svaku žicu čisto i pusti je da zvoni.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B, high G, low D, high D, G. Find each string by its note.
rows.translation: B, visoki G, niski D, visoki D, G. Pronađi svaku žicu po tonu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 3, then string 5. Which is higher?
rows.translation: Žica 3, pa žica 5. Koja je viša?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 5 (listen) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 1 · challenge bjo-1-5 “Open G challenge” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger frets the A; your thumb picks string 3.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb traži tri tona: prazna žica 2 je B, prag 2 na žici 3 je A, a prazna žica 3 je G. Drugi prst pritišće A; palac trza žicu 3.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 1 · song bjo-1-6 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The right-hand patterns behind the rolling bluegrass sound: pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll.
rows.translation: Obrasci desne ruke za tekući bluegrass zvuk: istodobni trzaj, izmjenični palac i obrazac naprijed.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 “Rolls” · unit summary

rows.source: A pinch is your thumb and middle finger plucking at the same moment, on strings 5 and 1. It sounds like a little two-note chord and often starts or ends a phrase.
rows.translation: Istodobni trzaj znači da palac i srednji prst trznu u isti čas, na žicama 5 i 1. Zvuči kao mali dvotonski akord i često počinje ili završava frazu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pinch, or one note at a time?
rows.translation: Istodobni trzaj ili ton po ton?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which strings does a pinch play?

Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Thumb on the short fifth string and middle on string 1, at the same moment.
rows.translation: Palac na kratkoj petoj žici i srednji prst na žici 1, u isti čas.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-1 “The pinch” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: This roll is eight even notes: thumb on 3, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1, then thumb on 4, index on 2, thumb on 5, middle on 1.
rows.translation: Ovaj obrazac ima osam ravnih tonova: palac na 3, kažiprst na 2, palac na 5, srednji na 1, pa palac na 4, kažiprst na 2, palac na 5, srednji na 1.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Which finger plays every other note?
rows.translation: Koji prst svira svaki drugi ton?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb, index, thumb, middle: the thumb plays every other note, which gives the roll its name.
rows.translation: Palac, kažiprst, palac, srednji: palac svira svaki drugi ton i po tome obrazac dobiva ime.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-2 “Alternating thumb roll” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The forward roll moves one way, thumb then index then middle, over and over. Eight notes make thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index.
rows.translation: Obrazac naprijed ide jednim smjerom, palac pa kažiprst pa srednji, ukrug. Osam tonova znači palac, kažiprst, srednji dvaput, pa palac, kažiprst.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: How does a forward roll fit into eight notes?
rows.translation: Kako obrazac naprijed stane u osam tonova?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle twice, then thumb, index. The accent shifts as it goes, which makes the rolling sound.
rows.translation: Palac, kažiprst, srednji dvaput, pa palac, kažiprst. Naglasak se usput pomiče i stvara tekući zvuk.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-3 “Forward roll” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A roll is only as good as its timing. Keep all eight notes even, like a ticking clock, and land the first note of each bar right on the beat.
rows.translation: Obrazac vrijedi koliko i njegov ritam. Drži svih osam tonova ravnima, poput sata, a prvi ton svakog takta postavi točno na dobu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 2 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: You lose the beat in the middle of a roll. What now?
rows.translation: Usred obrasca izgubiš ritam. Što sada?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Stop and start the bar over
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Slow down until it feels right
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Keep the right hand moving and rejoin
rows.translation: Nastavi desnom rukom i ponovno se uključi
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: In a band the beat never waits. Keep the pattern going and catch the next bar.
rows.translation: U sastavu ritam nikad ne čeka. Nastavi obrazac i uhvati sljedeći takt.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · lesson bjo-2-4 “Rolls in time” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pinch, alternating thumb and forward roll, all on open strings. Keep the eighths even and let every string ring.
rows.translation: Istodobni trzaj, izmjenični palac i obrazac naprijed, sve na praznim žicama. Drži osminke ravnima i pusti svaku žicu da zvoni.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which roll goes thumb, index, middle, over and over?
rows.translation: Koji obrazac stalno ide palac, kažiprst, srednji?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 2 · challenge bjo-2-5 “Roll challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fret G, C, D7 and E minor and keep the roll going through the changes.
rows.translation: Pritisni G, C, D7 i E-mol i nastavi obrazac kroz promjene.

Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third finger on fret 2 of string 1. Strings 3 and 5 ring open.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na pragu 1 žice 2, drugi prst na pragu 2 žice 4, treći prst na pragu 2 žice 1. Žice 3 i 5 zvone prazne.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Do you fret the fifth string for C?
rows.translation: Pritišćeš li petu žicu za C?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The open high G belongs to the C chord, so it rings as it is. You never fret it in these lessons.
rows.translation: Prazni visoki G pripada akordu C, pa zvoni takav kakav jest. U ovim lekcijama nikad ga ne pritišćeš na pragu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-1 “The C chord” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 3. Strings 4 and 1 ring open. Leave the fifth string out; its G clashes with D7.
rows.translation: Prvi prst na pragu 1 žice 2, drugi prst na pragu 2 žice 3. Žice 4 i 1 zvone prazne. Izostavi petu žicu; njezin G sukobljava se s D7.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The full D7, if you like
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The two-finger D7 has no F sharp. Add your little finger at fret 4 of string 1 and all four notes of D7 ring. Either shape works in the songs; the full one sounds richer.
rows.translation: D7 s dva prsta nema povišeni F. Dodaj mali prst na prag 4 žice 1 i zvone sva četiri tona D7. Oba hvata rade u pjesmama; puni zvuči bogatije.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-2 “D7” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The open G of string 5 isn't part of D7. For now your thumb keeps to strings 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Prazni G žice 5 nije dio D7. Zasad se palac drži žica 3 i 4.

Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: G is home, C steps away and D7 pulls you back. Change on the first beat of each bar and keep your right hand moving.
rows.translation: G je dom, C odmiče, a D7 te vraća. Mijenjaj na prvu dobu svakog takta i nastavi desnom rukom.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord pulls you back to G?
rows.translation: Koji te akord vraća u G?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 contains C, which leans down to B in the G chord. That pull is why so many songs end D7 to G.
rows.translation: D7 sadrži C, koji teži dolje prema B u akordu G. Zbog tog privlačenja mnoge pjesme završavaju prijelazom D7 u G.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-3 “G, C and D7” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Make C, then lift your first finger off string 2. Two fingers stay on fret 2, strings 4 and 1, and the chord turns darker: E minor.
rows.translation: Postavi C, pa podigni prvi prst sa žice 2. Dva prsta ostaju na pragu 2, na žicama 4 i 1, a akord postaje tamniji: E-mol.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · lesson bjo-3-4 “E minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Four chords and two rolls. Keep the right hand steady even while the left hand is busy changing.
rows.translation: Četiri akorda i dva obrasca. Drži desnu ruku ujednačenom čak i dok lijeva žurno mijenja.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 3 · challenge bjo-3-5 “Chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which string sits out on D7?
rows.translation: Koja žica ne svira u D7?

rows.source: Alternating thumb: G, C, D7, G
rows.translation: Izmjenični palac: G, C, D7, G

rows.translation: Obrazac naprijed: G, E-mol, C, D7, G

rows.source: Four traditional tunes, with the drone string ringing in among the melody.
rows.translation: Četiri tradicijske melodije, s bordunskom žicom koja zvoni među tonovima melodije.

rows.source: Here the melody is the main event: pick each note with the finger that owns its string. Strings 3, 2 and 1 carry this whole tune.
rows.translation: Ovdje je melodija glavna: trzaj svaki ton prstom zaduženim za njegovu žicu. Žice 3, 2 i 1 nose cijelu melodiju.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 2 open, string 3 fret 2, string 3 open, string 2 fret 1, string 1 open.
rows.translation: Žica 2 prazna, žica 3 prag 2, žica 3 prazna, žica 2 prag 1, žica 1 prazna.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note does the tune end on?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Tunes in G come home to G, here the open third string.
rows.translation: Melodije u G vraćaju se kući na G, ovdje praznu treću žicu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-1 “Boil Them Cabbage Down” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Cripple Creek has a high part that uses the fifth string as a melody note, and a low part down on strings 3 and 4. Take each part slowly first.
rows.translation: Cripple Creek ima visoki dio koji koristi petu žicu kao ton melodije i niski dio na žicama 3 i 4. Prvo sviraj svaki dio polako.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 5 open, then string 1 at fret 4 and fret 2.
rows.translation: Žica 5 prazna, pa žica 1 na pragu 4 i pragu 2.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where does the high G in the first bar come from?
rows.translation: Odakle dolazi visoki G u prvom taktu?

rows.source: The drone doubles as a melody note here. Your thumb plays it, right on the beat.
rows.translation: Bordun je ovdje ujedno ton melodije. Svira ga palac, točno na dobu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-2 “Cripple Creek” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A tune named for a mountain pass
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cumberland Gap is the pass early settlers took into Kentucky. The tune climbs to E and F♯ on string 1, so your second and fourth fingers get busy.
rows.translation: Cumberland Gap je prijevoj kojim su rani doseljenici ulazili u Kentucky. Melodija se penje do E i F♯ na žici 1, pa drugi i četvrti prst imaju posla.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 4, fret 2, then open.
rows.translation: Žica 1: prag 2, prag 4, prag 2, pa prazna.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Where do you play F♯ in this tune?
rows.translation: Gdje sviraš F♯ u ovoj melodiji?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: F♯ is four frets above the open D of string 1. The fifth string is never fretted here.
rows.translation: F♯ je četiri praga iznad praznog D žice 1. Petu žicu ovdje nikad ne pritišćeš na pragu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-3 “Cumberland Gap” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Shady Grove has the dark, old sound players call mountain minor. It comes to rest on A instead of G, and the high G of the fifth string sings against it.
rows.translation: Shady Grove ima taman, starinski zvuk koji svirači zovu planinski mol. Smiruje se na A umjesto G, a visoki G pete žice pjeva uz njega.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 4 · song bjo-4-4 “Shady Grove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3 fret 2, string 2 open, string 1 open, string 1 fret 2.
rows.translation: Žica 3 prag 2, žica 2 prazna, žica 1 prazna, žica 1 prag 2.

rows.translation: Koja se melodija smiruje na A umjesto G?

rows.source: Shady Grove is in mountain minor, centered on A. The others come home to G.

rows.translation: Oglasi tonove rukom na vratu, pa ih upotrijebi u Old Joe Clark.

rows.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.
rows.translation: Trzni praznu žicu, pa brzo spusti vrh prsta odmah iza praga 2. Novi ton nastaje samo od udarca, bez drugog trzaja.

rows.source: Pick string 3 open, then hammer fret 2 with your second finger.
rows.translation: Trzni praznu žicu 3, pa drugim prstom udari na prag 2.

rows.source: The pick sounds the first note. The second comes from your finger striking the string.
rows.translation: Trzalica oglašava prvi ton. Drugi dolazi od prsta koji udara žicu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Fret a note, pick it, then pull your finger slightly sideways as you lift. That flick plucks the open string, so a second note sounds without the pick.
rows.translation: Pritisni ton, trzni ga, pa pri podizanju prst malo povuci ustranu. Taj trzaj oglasi praznu žicu, pa drugi ton zvuči bez trzalice.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Pick string 1 at fret 2, then pull off to open.
rows.translation: Trzni žicu 1 na pragu 2, pa pull-offom prijeđi na praznu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which way does your finger move in a pull-off?
rows.translation: U kojem smjeru prst ide pri pull-offu?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Along the string to the next fret
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Lifting straight up only stops the note. A small sideways flick plucks the open string.
rows.translation: Podizanje ravno gore samo zaustavlja ton. Mali trzaj ustranu oglašava praznu žicu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-2 “Pull-offs” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Fret string 3 at fret 2, pick it, and slide the same finger up to fret 4 while pressing. A to B in one smooth glide is a classic banjo sound.
rows.translation: Pritisni žicu 3 na pragu 2, trzni i klizni istim prstom do praga 4 uz pritisak. Od A do B u jednom glatkom klizanju klasičan je zvuk bendža.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 2 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the first note is picked. Keep pressing as you glide, or the note dies on the way.
rows.translation: Trzaš samo prvi ton. Nastavi pritiskati dok kliziš, inače će se ton putem ugasiti.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 5 · lesson bjo-5-3 “Slides” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is in G, but its second part uses F instead of F♯, on string 1 at fret 3. That lowered note gives the tune its old-time sound.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je u G, ali drugi dio koristi F umjesto F♯, na žici 1, pragu 3. Taj sniženi ton daje melodiji starinski zvuk.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 1: fret 2, fret 3, fret 2, open. Try hammering from 2 to 3.
rows.translation: Žica 1: prag 2, prag 3, prag 2, prazna. Probaj hammer-on s 2 na 3.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which note gives the second part its old-time color?
rows.translation: Koji ton daje drugom dijelu starinsku boju?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: G major uses F♯. Lowering it to F gives the mixolydian sound that runs through old-time and bluegrass music.
rows.translation: G-dur koristi F♯. Spuštanje na F daje miksolidijski zvuk koji se provlači kroz starinsku i bluegrass glazbu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · song bjo-5-4 “Old Joe Clark” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · title
Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs and slides, then Old Joe Clark. Pick only where you need to and let your fretting hand do the rest.
rows.translation: Hammer-on, pull-off i slide, pa Old Joe Clark. Trzaj samo gdje treba i prepusti ostatak ruci na vratu.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which move glides a fretted note up to a higher fret?
rows.translation: Koji pokret klizno podiže pritisnuti ton do višeg praga?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 5 · challenge bjo-5-5 “Left-hand challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A different right hand: strike down with a fingernail and catch the drone with your thumb.
rows.translation: Drugačija desna ruka: udaraj noktom dolje i hvataj bordun palcem.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 “Clawhammer” · unit summary
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Clawhammer uses no picks. Curl your hand into a loose claw and strike down on a string with the back of your index or middle fingernail, moving from the wrist and forearm.
rows.translation: Clawhammer ne koristi trzalice. Savij ruku u opuštenu pandžu i udari žicu prema dolje vanjskom stranom nokta kažiprsta ili srednjeg prsta, pokretom iz zapešća i podlaktice.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: As your hand strikes, the thumb comes to rest on the fifth string. On the next beat it pushes through that string as your hand lifts.
rows.translation: Dok ruka udara, palac sjeda na petu žicu. Na sljedeću dobu prolazi kroz nju dok se ruka podiže.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which way does your fingernail move in clawhammer?
rows.translation: U kojem se smjeru nokat kreće u clawhammeru?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Clawhammer strikes down with the nail. The fingers never pluck upward.
rows.translation: Clawhammer udara noktom dolje. Prsti nikad ne trzaju prema gore.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-1 “A new right hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The basic clawhammer rhythm sounds like its name. Bum: strike one note on the beat. Dit: brush down across the strings. Ty: your thumb plays string 5.
rows.translation: Osnovni clawhammer ritam zvuči poput svog imena. Bum: udari jedan ton na dobu. Di: prijeđi dolje preko žica. Ti: palac svira žicu 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which part of bum-ditty does the thumb play?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum je jedan ton, di je potez preko žica, a ti palac na petoj žici.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
rows.translation: U clawhammeru tonovi melodije padaju na udare bum. Potez preko žica i palac ispunjavaju prostor oko njih, pa melodija i ritam izlaze zajedno.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Where do the melody notes go in bum-ditty?
rows.translation: Gdje dolaze tonovi melodije u bum-diti?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The bum lands on the beat, so that is where the melody goes. Dit and ty keep the rhythm rolling.
rows.translation: Bum pada na dobu, pa ondje ide melodija. Di i ti održavaju ritam.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Skip to My Lou was a party game in the 1840s. In clawhammer each melody note is a bum, followed by a brush and the thumb on string 5.
rows.translation: Skip to My Lou bila je društvena igra u 1840-ima. U clawhammeru svaki ton melodije je bum, nakon kojeg slijede potez preko žica i palac na žici 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What does your thumb play after each brush?
rows.translation: Što palac svira nakon svakog poteza preko žica?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bum, dit, ty: the ty is always the thumb on the short fifth string.
rows.translation: Bum, di, ti: ti je uvijek palac na kratkoj petoj žici.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Everything in clawhammer comes back to bum-ditty. Keep the motion loose and the thumb ready, and the melody takes care of itself.
rows.translation: Sve u clawhammeru vraća se na bum-diti. Drži pokret opuštenim, palac spremnim i melodija će se pobrinuti za sebe.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which hand shape does clawhammer use?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

Ear Training course · title

rows.source: Hear intervals and chords, and sing back what you hear
rows.translation: Prepoznaj intervale i akorde te otpjevaj što čuješ
rows.context: Ear Training course · course subtitle
Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · title

rows.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
rows.translation: Razlikuj koji je od dva tona viši, od širokih skokova do najmanjeg koraka.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · title

rows.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
rows.translation: Visina označava koliko ton zvuči visoko ili nisko. Na klavijaturi niski tonovi su lijevo, visoki desno. Uho već zna razliku; ovdje je izoštravaš.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
rows.translation: Kad je drugi ton viši, melodija ide gore. Kad je niži, ide dolje. Dok slušaš, prati smjer rukom u zraku.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does the second note go up or down?
rows.translation: Ide li drugi ton gore ili dolje?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
rows.translation: Što su tonovi bliži, teže ih je razlikovati. Pusti svaki ton da završi prije odgovora. Svaki odgovor, točan ili pogrešan, vježba sluh.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
rows.translation: Nisi siguran? Pjevuši prvi ton, pa klizni glasom do drugog. Osjeti penje li se glas ili spušta. Tijelo zna smjer.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · title

rows.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
rows.translation: Mnoge melodije idu do sljedećeg tona ljestvice: mali korak. Koraci zvuče glatko i blisko. Slušaj blag uspon ili pad umjesto skoka.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
rows.translation: Drži prvi ton u glavi dok svira drugi. Zatim ih usporedi, kao dvije visine jednu uz drugu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
rows.translation: Najmanji korak u većini glazbe je poluton: od jedne tipke do odmah sljedeće. To je sićušan pomak i možeš ga naučiti čuti.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
rows.translation: Kod sićušnih koraka prvi dojam obično je točan. Odgovori i ne razuvjeravaj se.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
rows.translation: Široki skokovi, mali koraci i polutonovi, visoko i nisko, sve pomiješano. Udahni prije svakog.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · title

rows.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
rows.translation: Čuj kad se dva tona podudaraju, pa uskladi ton glasom ili instrumentom.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · title

rows.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
rows.translation: Dva se tona podudaraju kad imaju potpuno istu visinu. Slušaj dolazi li drugi točno na prvi ili odmiče od njega.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
rows.translation: Dva glasa pjevaju potpuno istu visinu. Kako to zovemo?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
rows.translation: Pjevati unisono znači pjevati potpuno isti ton.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
rows.translation: Za usklađivanje visine poslušaj, čuj ton ponovno u glavi, pa ga otpjevaj ili odsviraj. Timbre pokazuje jesi li previsoko ili prenisko. Klizi dok ga ne pogodiš.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj ili odsviraj ton koji upravo čuješ.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj ili odsviraj drugi ton koji čuješ.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
rows.translation: Ako promašiš, ne staj. Polako klizi gore ili dolje dok ton ne sjedne. Tim klizanjem sluh i glas uče surađivati.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
rows.translation: Prije pjevanja ponovno čuj ton u glavi, u tišini. Glazbenici to zovu audijacija: slušanje glazbe koja ne zvuči naglas. To je srž dobrog sluha.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
rows.translation: Sada uskladi dva tona zaredom. Otpjevaj prvi, pa prijeđi na drugi. Primijeti penje li se glas ili spušta do njega.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj ili odsviraj upravo odsvirane tonove redom.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
rows.translation: Isto ili različito, pojedini tonovi i parovi. Poslušaj sve do kraja prije pjevanja i klizi dok svaki ton ne sjedne.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · title

rows.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
rows.translation: Čuj polutonove i cijele tonove, pa širi skok terce.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
rows.translation: Poluton ide do odmah sljedeće tipke. Cijeli ton preskače jednu tipku, pa je jednak dvama polutonovima. Oba zvuče kao korak, ali cijeli ton otvara malo širi prostor.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
rows.translation: Cijeli ton preskače jednu tipku, pa čini dva polutona.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
rows.translation: Glazbenici korak zovu sekunda jer ide do sljedećeg slova: C do D. Poluton je mala sekunda. Cijeli ton je velika sekunda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: E up to F is a...
rows.translation: Od E gore do F je...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E and F have no key between them: a half step, so a minor second.
rows.translation: E i F nemaju tipku između: poluton, dakle mala sekunda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: C up to D is a...
rows.translation: Od C gore do D je...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
rows.translation: Od C do D preskačeš crnu tipku između: cijeli ton, dakle velika sekunda.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
rows.translation: Korak vodi do sljedećeg slova. Skok preskače jedno, primjerice od C do E, preko D. Taj se razmak zove terca. Skokovi zvuče otvorenije od koraka.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D up to F is a...
rows.translation: Od D naviše do F je...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D to F jumps over E, so it's a skip: a third.
rows.translation: Od D do F preskače se E, pa je to skok: terca.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
rows.translation: Velika terca obuhvaća četiri polutona i zvuči vedro. Mala terca obuhvaća tri i zvuči tamnije, pomalo sjetno. Slušaj vedrinu zvuka.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: C up to E spans how many half steps?
rows.translation: Koliko polutonova ima od C naviše do E?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: četiri polutona, dakle velika terca.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
rows.translation: Polutonovi, cijeli tonovi i terce, uzlazno i silazno. Prvo odredi je li korak ili skok, a zatim točnu veličinu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · title

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
rows.translation: Unisono, oktava, kvinta i kvarta, svaki uz melodiju koju možeš pjevušiti.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
rows.translation: Interval je udaljenost između dvaju tonova. Unisono nema razmaka: isti ton dvaput. Oktava ide od jednog slova do istog slova iznad, primjerice od C do C. Zvuči kao jedan ton, samo svjetlije.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
rows.translation: Zvončići počinju ponavljanjem jednog tona: unisonom. Take Me Out to the Ball Game počinje skokom za oktavu naviše. Pjevuši oba početka da prizoveš zvuk.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Why is it called an octave?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: eight letter names, counting both ends.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C: osam slovnih naziva, računajući oba kraja.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · title

rows.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
rows.translation: Čista kvinta obuhvaća sedam polutonova, primjerice od C naviše do G. Zvuči otvoreno i snažno. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star nakon prva dva tona skače za kvintu naviše.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
rows.translation: Koji je ton čistu kvintu iznad D?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.translation: Izbroji pet slova: D, E, F, G, A. Od D do A ima sedam polutonova.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · title

rows.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
rows.translation: Čista kvarta obuhvaća pet polutonova, primjerice od C naviše do F. Zvuči poput poziva na pozornost. Amazing Grace počinje uzlaznom kvartom.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Obje zvuče otvoreno. Kvinta je šira i djeluje smireno. Kvarta kao da želi krenuti dalje. Ako se dvoumiš, pjevuši melodiju za svaku.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A fifth spans seven half steps; a fourth spans five.
rows.translation: Kvinta obuhvaća sedam polutonova, a kvarta pet.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
rows.translation: Interval zadržava naziv bez obzira na to uzlazi li ili silazi. Od G naniže do C i dalje je kvinta. Slušaj veličinu razmaka, a ne smjer.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
rows.translation: Kad dva tona zvuče zajedno, slušaj kako se stapaju. Oktava se slijeva u jedan zvuk. Kvinta zvuči šuplje i snažno. Kvarta zvuči otvoreno, ali nemirno.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj ili odsviraj silaznu kvintu: od G naniže do C.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, rising, falling and together. If you get stuck, hum the tune for each.
rows.translation: Unisono, oktava, kvinta i kvarta, uzlazno, silazno i zajedno. Ako zapneš, pjevuši melodiju za svaki.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · challenge ear-4-5 “Intervals I challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · title

rows.source: Thirds, sixths and seconds in their major and minor sizes.
rows.translation: Terce, sekste i sekunde u velikom i malom obliku.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 “Intervals II” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In počinje velikom tercom, vedrom i odvažnom. Greensleeves počinje malom tercom, nježnijom i tužnijom. Pjevuši obje da zapamtiš zvukove.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many half steps are in a minor third?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
rows.translation: Mala terca obuhvaća tri polutona, primjerice od A do C. Velika terca obuhvaća četiri.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · title

rows.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.
rows.translation: Velika seksta obuhvaća devet polutonova; njome počinje My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean. Mala seksta obuhvaća osam i zvuči tamnije. The Entertainer skače za taj interval naviše odmah nakon brzih uvodnih tonova.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: C up to A is which interval?
rows.translation: Koji je interval od C naviše do A?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to A spans nine half steps: a major sixth.
rows.translation: Od C do A ima devet polutonova: velika seksta.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-2 “Sixths” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.
rows.translation: Bratec Martin počinje velikom sekundom, cijelim tonom naviše. Za Elizu počinje njihanjem naniže pa naviše za malu sekundu, odnosno poluton. Mali razmaci, velika razlika.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which interval is a half step?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A minor second is one half step. A major second is two.
rows.translation: Mala sekunda je jedan poluton. Velika sekunda ima dva.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play the rocking half step: E, D♯, E.
rows.translation: Otpjevaj ili odsviraj njihanje za poluton: E, D♯, E.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-3 “Seconds you know” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.
rows.translation: Prvo procijeni veličinu: korak, skok ili širok skok. Zatim boju: vedru za veliki, tamniju za mali interval. Dva laka izbora bolja su od jednog teškog pogađanja.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Minor intervals sound darker than their major partners.
rows.translation: Mali intervali zvuče tamnije od odgovarajućih velikih.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-4 “Mixing sizes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Seconds, thirds and sixths, major and minor, mixed with the fourths and fifths you already know.
rows.translation: Sekunde, terce i sekste, velike i male, pomiješane s već poznatim kvartama i kvintama.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · challenge ear-5-5 “Intervals II challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · title

rows.source: Hear major and minor chords, then diminished, augmented and dominant seventh.
rows.translation: Prepoznaj durske i molske akorde, zatim smanjene, povećane i dominantne septakorde.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 “Chord qualities” · unit summary
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.
rows.translation: Akord čine tri ili više tonova koji zvuče zajedno. Durski akord zvuči vedro i smireno. Molski zvuči tamnije. Razlikuju se samo po srednjem tonu.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A major chord turns minor. How many of its notes change?
rows.translation: Durski akord postaje molski. Koliko se njegovih tonova mijenja?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Only the middle note, the third, drops a half step: C E G becomes C E♭ G.
rows.translation: Samo srednji ton, terca, pada za poluton: C E G postaje C E♭ G.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Sing or play back the chord's notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Ponovi tonove akorda pjevanjem ili sviranjem, od niskog prema visokom.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-1 “Major or minor?” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Unsure? Focus on the middle note. In a major chord it sits four half steps above the bottom. In minor it sits one half step lower, which darkens everything.
rows.translation: Dvoumiš se? Usredotoči se na srednji ton. U durskom akordu on je četiri polutona iznad najnižeg. U molskom je poluton niže, što sve čini tamnijim.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which notes spell a C minor chord?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Lower the middle note of C major by a half step: E becomes E♭.
rows.translation: Snizi srednji ton C-dura za poluton: E postaje E♭.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-2 “Major and minor everywhere” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A diminished chord stacks two minor thirds and sounds tight and uneasy. An augmented chord stacks two major thirds and sounds stretched, like a question left hanging.
rows.translation: Smanjeni akord slaže dvije male terce i zvuči stisnuto i nelagodno. Povećani akord slaže dvije velike terce i zvuči rastegnuto, poput pitanja koje ostaje bez odgovora.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which kind of chord is this?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · question or instruction
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 3 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: Which chord stacks two major thirds?
rows.translation: Koji akord slaže dvije velike terce?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: A major third plus a major third, like C E G♯, makes an augmented chord.
rows.translation: Velika terca uz veliku tercu, primjerice C E G♯, tvori povećani akord.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-3 “Diminished and augmented” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.
rows.translation: Dominantni septakord je durski akord s još jednim tonom na vrhu: malom septimom iznad osnovnog tona, po kojem akord nosi ime. Zvuči bluesovski i nemirno.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G7 is G major (G B D) plus F, a minor seventh above G.
rows.translation: G7 je G-dur (G B D) uz F, malu septimu iznad G.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 6 · lesson ear-6-4 “The dominant seventh” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 6 · challenge ear-6-5 “Chord qualities challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Major, minor, diminished, augmented and dominant seventh: bright, dark, tight, stretched, restless. Name the color, then the chord.
